nextExecutableAction: Lead validates this preflight against its dispatch packet, then waits for its wave0 commit and accepted RS-AUT-03 receipt before implementation. At that committed revision, re-read changed source hashes and runtime-contracts.ts, confirm common service/registry/log grant/cursor/proof contracts and one-writer shared patch ownership. First implementation slice: authorized readAttempt/readLogs in normative run-queries.ts with graph-only denied input/export control, wired to WorkflowDebugDrawer in existing graph workspace; do not start a parallel store or use testAutomation as live-proof runtime.
risks: Live success inflation: generic verification flag, quick-test success, prompt session dispatch or webhook 2xx is not operation-bound provider readback.
Private payload leakage through persisted data/results, stderr, error titles, nested JSON tree, clipboard, search or export; UI-only redaction is insufficient.
Graph-read permission silently granting log inputs/export; common generic read permission helper lacks log resource scoping by itself.
History compaction assumes id=automation matcher; using run IDs or node rows in existing JSONL can defeat retention/grouping or erase required durable attempts.
Logger buffer has no size cap or durable cursor; batching/requeue/UUID alone cannot prove ordered reconnect or duplicate-free UI.
Retry via current runNow auto-saves and executes actions; read/config/focus navigation must not use that path or replay irreversible effects.
Mutable authoring graph revision mistaken for immutable published run revision; old attempts must not change when draft is fixed.
Missing workspace-service/runtime-contracts paths mean normative new query file cannot be integrated before service/runtime foundations land; source-only drawer cannot satisfy package.
Root wave0/shared files may change after inspection. All plan references must be rechecked against accepted hashes before patching; report is not a feature completion receipt.
No UI-only N/A exemption applies: this package explicitly includes runtime data, ACL, proofs, live effects and reconnect. All three ACs and all six DoD items remain required.
